svg.aria-label: Two trajectories of the top-left pixel against log signal-to-noise ratio: the VE value explodes past minus three as noise grows while the VP value stays within one, and the rescaled VE curve lies exactly on the VP curve
svg.text: VARIANCE-PRESERVING AND VARIANCE-EXPLODING: ONE PATH, RESCALED
Same information at every noise level; only the scale differs, and the scale is known.
Computed for x₀ = 0.95 with the fixed draw ε = −0.55 at every level; real corruption draws fresh noise, the rescaling identity holds per draw.
